name: Spatial Consistency Detection Task
description: A benchmark that tests multimodal large language models' ability to reason about 3D geometry across views by identifying objects that violate spatial consistency in pairs of images. The dataset is created automatically using object segmentation, inpainting, and cross-view replacement to introduce geometric inconsistencies without manual annotation.
reputation: A recent multimodal reasoning benchmark that is still emerging in the community and has not yet seen broad long-term adoption.
notes: Dataset created via automatic method for geometric inconsistencies; fine-tuning improves model performance and generalization.
